substeps.caption: The frame is up. A bare board goes onto the vacuum nest.
The vision assist lines the stencil's apertures up with the pads; the frame comes down onto the board.
The print head drives a squeegee across: paste rolls ahead of the blade and fills the apertures.
The frame lifts straight up off the board, leaving the paste on the pads.
The pasted board goes on to the pick-and-place.
